cohort: 4318 singleton pregnancies (gestational age >28 weeks) at a teaching hospital in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, from January 2003 to December 2020, including 2162 women aged 40 years or older
finding: Advanced maternal age is an independent risk factor for adverse obstetric outcomes, including CS, antepartum hemorrhage, diabetes mellitus, hypertension, PROM, postpartum hemorrhage, and fetal complications.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500 g) and macrosomia (3600-4500 g) were observed in newborns of AMA women
